global_caption: A realistic cinematic scene featuring one small orange tabby cat with short fur, one small red toy ball, and a cozy living room with oak wooden floors, a beige fabric sofa, and warm morning sunlight entering through a window. The same cat, red ball, furniture, lighting, and room layout remain visually consistent across all five consecutive shots. The story follows the cat discovering, playing with, and retrieving the red ball. Natural feline movements, realistic physics, cinematic composition, and gentle continuity of action.
shot1: A medium shot of the orange tabby cat slowly walking toward the small red ball resting on the wooden floor. The cat pauses and looks curiously at the ball. The camera remains stationary.
shot2: A close-up of the same orange tabby cat gently touching the red ball with its right front paw. The cat pushes the ball forward, causing it to roll away across the wooden floor. The camera remains steady at floor level.
shot3: A side tracking shot of the same orange tabby cat walking after the rolling red ball across the living room. The ball moves naturally toward the beige sofa while the cat follows it. The camera smoothly tracks the movement from the side.
shot4: A low-angle shot near the beige sofa. The small red ball slows down and stops on the wooden floor directly in front of the sofa. The same orange tabby cat approaches, lowers its head, and carefully sniffs the stationary ball. The camera remains stationary.
shot5: A wide shot of the same cozy living room. The orange tabby cat gently pushes the red ball away from the sofa with its front paw, then follows it a short distance. The ball gradually comes to a stop, and the cat sits quietly beside it in the warm morning sunlight. The camera remains stationary.
